metadata.agent_last_message:
The simulator is built and works correctly with the exact invocation form specified in the prompt. Final summary:

**Built:** `/workspace/output/` Cargo project, no external dependencies, builds to a single binary.

**Modules:**
- `main.rs` — CLI argument parsing and orchestration  
- `parse.rs` — RS274/NGC lexer/parser with full expression and parameter support  
- `state.rs` — Machine state model with all modal groups  
- `exec.rs` — Block execution: motion, canned cycles, probing, G28/G30, G92, tool changes  
- `trace.rs` — Trace stepping (time/distance/tolerance) and delta serialization  
- `io.rs` — Tool-table and parameter-file I/O, output-JSON serialization  

**What works:**
- All G-codes G0–G99 (motion modes, canned cycles, coord systems, distance/units modes, probing, dwell, etc.)
- All M-codes M0–M60 (program flow, spindle, coolant, tool change, overrides)
- Modal-group tracking with all default values
- Expressions, unary functions, parameter reads/writes (incl. parallel-write semantics)
- Multi-coord-system support with G10 and G92.x family
- Canned cycles G81–G89 with sub-motion expansion, sticky values, G98/G99 retract modes, multi-repeat in incremental mode
- G28/G30 with intermediate-point handling and home parameters
- G38.2 probing against a configurable axis-aligned probe-box, with parameter 5061-5066 writes
- Tool length offsets (G43/G49) shifting the controlled point through TLO transitions
- All three trace stepping modes: time, distance, position-tolerance (adaptive subdivision)
- Trace deltas matching all the rules in the prompt (motion_kind on first emitted entry of each canned-cycle sub-motion, nonmodal_g_codes labels, post-motion fold + trailing-entry for G84/G86/G87 spindle restore, etc.)
- M2/M30 reset effects on modal groups and parameters
- Block-delete switch via `--block-delete`
- Parameter-input loading and parameter-output writing per RS274 §3.2.1

**Verified against prompt examples:** Example 1 (linear motion) and Example 2 (G81
